title: verification_argv from hunch_task start passed a Windows path to --import in source checkouts, so hunch task verify never ran and cards showed no check
observation: Observed 2026-09-15 on Windows in the hunch source checkout. verificationLauncher() in src/mcp/taskReportTools.ts built the dev launcher as [node, '--import', fileURLToPath(import.meta.resolve('tsx')), cli]. Node's --import requires a URL; on Windows the converted path yields ERR_UNSUPPORTED_ESM_URL_SCHEME ("Received protocol 'c:'"), so every `hunch task verify` launched with the MCP-provided argv failed before running the command. Because the agent copies that argv verbatim (as the grounding block instructs), every contribution card on this machine read 'No independent command result recorded' even when the suite had been run. The same defect family hit the test harness (tsxLoaderUrl fix in #240). Published builds are unaffected: dist launches pass no --import. Fix: keep the resolved loader as a file URL (pathToFileURL when needed); test asserts the --import argument starts with file:. Resolved in fix/verify-launcher-url.
evidence: hunch task verify <id> -- npx tsx --test … via the MCP verification_argv (PowerShell) -> Error [ERR_UNSUPPORTED_ESM_URL_SCHEME]: … Received protocol 'c:'
